# Ruby

Ruby is a ruby-red colour scheme tuned for dark-mode Obsidian, aiming at a warm, high-contrast look. It records support for a Palatinate snippet for consistent accents alongside its wider UI styling. The index marks this theme as legacy.

![Ruby screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-ruby/HEAD/example.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ruby"
    author: "gracejoseph1236"
    repo:   "gracejoseph1236/obsidian-ruby"
    slug:   "ruby"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ruby"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-ruby"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gracejoseph1236/obsidian-ruby/HEAD/example.png"

    modes:  ["dark"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a ruby-red color scheme tuned for dark-mode Obsidian to give notes a warm, high-contrast look. Include Palatinate snippet support for consistent accents and refined UI styling."
}
```
